licence.summary: No licence stated by the author
licence.redistribution: Manual author-page download only. NeoStation does not host, repackage or redistribute these files; no redistribution permission is inferred.

entries.notes: Legacy texture naming must pass the current Dolphin installer before this reference can become installable. The author identifies NTSC USA; PAL and French are not confirmed. UI and 2D elements only, with remaining omissions.
entries.reason: Legacy Dolphin filename/hash scheme; the author advises PAL redumping/renaming. The CI host blocked the archive, so current tex1 compatibility cannot be attested. Not in the runtime catalogue.
